title: 第1185章 宗主出手第1184章 刘仪绝望
slug: 开局一枚玉佩凡女低调修仙
lines: 巨手的力量倾泻而下，连同断裂的法宝一起，狠狠砸在刘仪的护体罡气上。
第一层雷火罡气瞬间碎裂。
第二层罡气仅仅支撑了数息，便在巨大的压力下崩溃。
最后一层罡气发出一阵刺耳的摩擦声，随后如同脆弱的琉璃一般，轰然炸碎。
金色巨手结结实实地拍击在刘仪的胸口之上。
刘仪狂喷出一口夹杂着内脏碎块的鲜血，整个身体如同断线的风筝一般，向后倒飞出去足足数十丈远，重重地砸在绝壁之上。
坚硬的绝壁被撞出一个深坑，周围的岩石纷纷脱落。
刘仪从绝壁上滑落，软绵绵地倒在碎石堆中。
他的胸骨已经完全粉碎，四肢百骸皆断，全身的经脉在玄天翻云手的重击下，寸寸断裂。
丹田内的元婴更是萎靡不振，表面布满了裂痕。
在绝对的境界压制与阵法配合下，这位权势滔天的刑罚长老，仅仅一招便被彻底重创，失去了所有的反抗能力。
萧玄收回右手，散去半空中的金色巨手。
迈开步伐，萧玄面无表情地走到刘仪身旁。
居高临下地看着这个曾经在门派内呼风唤雨的长老。
刘仪口中不断溢出鲜血，双眼死死盯着萧玄，喉咙里发出嗬嗬的声响，却连一句完整的话都说不出来。
萧玄缓缓蹲下身子。
没有胜利者的炫耀，也没有对失败者的嘲讽。
萧玄的眼中只有对纯净真元的极度渴望。
萧玄伸出右手，五指张开，直接按在刘仪残破的丹田之上。
“你的造化，本座收下了。”
萧玄低语一声，随后开始施展禁忌之术——夺基秘术！
这是一门能够强行抽出他人体内的本源真气与修为根基的功法。
萧玄五指猛地发力，指尖刺破刘仪的皮肤，直接扣住了刘仪丹田内部的那个残破元婴。
夺基秘术全面运转。
刘仪的双眼猛地凸起，脸上的肌肉因为极度的痛苦而剧烈扭曲变形。
他张开大嘴，发出一声惨绝人寰的凄厉嘶嚎。
这声音在空旷的禁闭谷内回荡，令人毛骨悚然。
萧玄不为所动，掌心爆发出强烈的吞噬之力。
只见一股股浓郁的暗红色真元，夹杂着纯净的无属性灵气，顺着萧玄的五指，源源不断地从刘仪体内被强行抽出。
这些真元，正是刘仪通过黑色令牌，从地底阵枢中吸纳而来的造化。
真元进入萧玄的体内，立刻沿着经脉流入他的丹田。
萧玄的脸色瞬间变得潮红，呼吸急促。
这股力量太过庞大，且纯净无比，直接冲击着他那停滞了百余年的境界壁垒。
抽取过程并非一帆风顺。
当萧玄试图连同刘仪的元婴本源一起抽出时，遭到了刘仪本能的拼死抵抗。
刘仪那布满裂痕的元婴，在丹田内疯狂挣扎，释放出带有毁灭气息的雷火之力，顺着经脉逆流而上，试图攻击萧玄的手臂。
content_en:
The power of the giant hand poured down, and together with the broken magic weapon, it hit Liu Yi's body-protecting Qi hard.
The first layer of thunder and fire energy shattered instantly.
The second layer of Gang Qi only lasted for a few breaths before collapsing under the tremendous pressure.
The last layer of Gang Qi made a harsh friction sound, and then exploded like fragile glass.
The giant golden hand slapped Liu Yi firmly on the chest.
Liu Yi spat out a mouthful of blood mixed with fragments of internal organs, and his whole body flew backwards like a kite with its string broken, dozens of feet away, and hit the cliff heavily.
The hard cliff was knocked out of a deep pit, and the surrounding rocks fell off.
Liu Yi slipped from the cliff and fell limply into the rubble.
His sternum had been completely shattered, all limbs and bones were broken, and all the meridians in his body were broken inch by inch under the heavy blow of Xuantian Fanyun's hand.
The Nascent Soul in Dantian was even more depressed, and its surface was full of cracks.
With the absolute realm suppression and the cooperation of the formation, this powerful punishment elder was completely severely injured with just one move and lost all ability to resist.
Xiao Xuan retracted his right hand and dispersed the giant golden hand in mid-air.
Taking steps forward, Xiao Xuan walked to Liu Yi expressionlessly.
Looking condescendingly at this elder who once made all the difference in the sect.
Liu Yi's mouth continued to overflow with blood, her eyes stared at Xiao Xuan, her throat made a whooshing sound, but she couldn't even say a complete sentence.
Xiao Xuan slowly squatted down.
There is no showing off from the winners and no mocking of the losers.
Xiao Xuan only had an extreme desire for pure true energy in his eyes.
Xiao Xuan stretched out his right hand, spread his fingers, and pressed directly on Liu Yi's broken Dantian.
"I accept your creation."
Xiao Xuan whispered, and then began to perform the forbidden technique - the secret technique of seizing the foundation!
This is a technique that can forcibly extract the original energy and cultivation foundation from other people's bodies.
Xiao Xuan's five fingers suddenly exerted force, and his fingertips pierced Liu Yi's skin, directly grabbing the broken Nascent Soul inside Liu Yi's Dantian.
The secret technique of seizing the foundation is in full operation.
Liu Yi's eyes suddenly bulged, and the muscles on his face were violently twisted and deformed due to extreme pain.
He opened his mouth and let out a miserable howl.
The sound echoed in the empty Forbidden Valley, making it creepy.
Xiao Xuan was unmoved, and a strong devouring power erupted from his palm.
I saw streams of rich dark red essence, mixed with pure attributeless spiritual energy, being forcefully extracted from Liu Yi's body along Xiao Xuan's five fingers.
These true essences are exactly what Liu Yi absorbed from the underground formation hub through the black token.
The true energy entered Xiao Xuan's body and immediately flowed into his Dantian along the meridians.
Xiao Xuan's face turned red instantly and his breathing became rapid.
This power was too huge and extremely pure, directly impacting his realm barrier that had been stagnant for more than a hundred years.
The extraction process was not smooth sailing.
When Xiao Xuan tried to extract Liu Yi's Yuanying origin together, he was met with Liu Yi's instinctive and desperate resistance.
Liu Yi's Nascent Soul, which was full of cracks, struggled wildly in his Dantian, releasing the power of thunder and fire with a destructive aura, flowing upstream along the meridians, trying to attack Xiao Xuan's arm.
title_en: Chapter 1185 The Sect Leader takes action Chapter 1184 Liu Yi is desperate
